comment: Grandfather sets that may only shrink. Every waiver here names an exception to a fail-closed rule that newer machinery enforces; tests/test_waiver_ratchet.py recomputes each population from live state and fails if it exceeds this manifest. Adding a member is a deliberate, reviewable manifest edit; nothing may join silently.

pre_cutover_v1_registrations.description: Target registration snapshots minted under schema v1, before registeredAtUtc existed. Immutable history; the count is frozen because trusted history can no longer mint v1.

pre_cutover_v2_registrations.description: Target registration snapshots minted under schema v2, before the v3 ledgerPin cutover. Immutable history; the count is frozen because trusted history can no longer mint v2.

templateless_docket_series.description: Docket series without a committed extras.sourceBinding template: binding upgrades are impossible for them, and their registrations bind under pre-template rules. Members leave this list by gaining a template; new series must ship with one.

legacy_incomplete_custody_roots.description: Custody roots recorded before custody inventory v2, honestly marked legacy-incomplete and permanently headline-ineligible. Immutable history; frozen.
